note: The list of media EPIC N owes, and since #1320 the media EPIC T owes (ids encryption-25 onwards), and the one place #997 looks up an id, a file name and its alt text. A still has four variants (variants[].suffix). state needs-ui-state means the stack has no UI state to photograph; the release gate counts its files as missing until the state exists and the entry becomes capturable. Store-submission screenshots are not here and are never generated.

stills.name: encryption-01-settings-off
stills.alt: Settings, Retained-copy encryption, off
stills.caption: Retained-copy encryption is off by default: one switch and a sentence, no key field.

stills.name: encryption-02-enable-dialog
stills.alt: Enable retained-copy encryption dialog
stills.caption: Turning it on asks one question, who holds the key, and echoes the command it runs.

stills.name: encryption-03-settings-on-unconfirmed
stills.alt: Settings card with encryption on and no confirmed recovery bundle
stills.caption: A managed key exists and the missing-bundle notice stays until a person confirms a bundle is stored.

stills.name: encryption-04-export-bundle
stills.alt: Export recovery bundle dialog
stills.caption: Download arms only after the tick, and nothing is rendered on screen. The fixture holds no key.

stills.name: encryption-05-bundle-confirmed
stills.alt: Settings card with the recovery bundle confirmed
stills.caption: Confirmation is a statement with a time, and the notice is gone.

stills.name: encryption-06-external-reference
stills.alt: External key reference dialog with a failed test
stills.caption: One single-line reference, three sources, and a three-answer test (resolves, declared but unreachable, not declared).

stills.name: encryption-07-rotate-confirm
stills.alt: Rotate the managed key dialog
stills.caption: Rotation makes a new active key and keeps the old one readable for the copies that record it.

stills.name: encryption-08-rotated
stills.alt: Managed keys table after a rotation
stills.caption: The previous key is superseded, not gone, and the new one is not yet confirmed.

stills.name: encryption-09-retire-refused
stills.alt: Retire refused naming the copies
stills.caption: A key that active copies still record cannot be retired, and the refusal says how many copies need it.

stills.name: encryption-10-key-missing-settings
stills.alt: Settings card when a required key does not resolve
stills.caption: Drawn as itself: copies are refused, nothing is deleted.

stills.name: encryption-11-key-missing-dashboard
stills.alt: Dashboard health row when a required key does not resolve
stills.caption: The same condition on the dashboard, so it is not found only by opening Settings.

stills.name: encryption-12-set-inherit
stills.alt: Per-set encryption control on Inherit
stills.caption: Inherit says what it resolves to from the deployment setting.

stills.name: encryption-13-set-required
stills.alt: Per-set encryption control on Required
stills.caption: An explicit Required is distinguishable from Inherit.

stills.name: encryption-14-set-required-key-missing
stills.alt: Per-set control, Required, key missing
stills.caption: The set is drawn as refusing and says nothing was deleted.

stills.name: encryption-15-copies-chips
stills.alt: Copies table with a plaintext and an encrypted copy
stills.caption: A plaintext local copy and an encrypted off-site copy that is not decrypt-verified, side by side.

stills.name: encryption-16-copies-key-missing
stills.alt: Copies table with a key-missing copy
stills.caption: A copy whose key does not resolve is Key missing and offers no verify action.

stills.name: encryption-17-verify-dialog
stills.alt: Verify recoverable dialog
stills.caption: Names the egress cost, needs the acceptance, and echoes the equivalent command.

stills.name: encryption-18-verify-running
stills.alt: Verify recoverable running
stills.caption: Accepted, key resolved, decrypt-verifying. Named progress stages are an undecided contract, so none are drawn.

stills.name: encryption-19-backups-list
stills.alt: Backups list with an Encryption column
stills.caption: Plaintext and Encrypted chips per copy on the list. The column exists only when a listed copy is encrypted.

stills.name: encryption-20-settings-exported
stills.alt: Settings card with a bundle exported and not yet confirmed
stills.caption: Exported is recorded on the key, so it survives a reload, and it is still not confirmed.

stills.name: encryption-21-key-copies-count
stills.alt: Managed keys table with a per-key copy count
stills.caption: Each key shows how many copies record it, linking to the Backups list filtered to that key.

stills.name: encryption-22-verified-recoverable
stills.alt: Encrypted and Verified recoverable chips on one copy
stills.caption: The two indicators side by side, visibly different.

stills.name: encryption-23-verify-matched
stills.alt: Verify recoverable ended in a match
stills.caption: The plaintext digest equals the catalog's, and the copy is Verified recoverable.

stills.name: encryption-24-verify-failed
stills.alt: Verify recoverable ended failed closed
stills.caption: Decrypt failed, no partial plaintext written, recover from another copy.

stills.name: encryption-25-suite-select
stills.reason: Waits on the T2.3 Settings suite select (#1318) and a mock scenario that draws it; becomes capturable with a steps entry once that UI exists.
stills.alt: Settings, Retained-copy encryption, the Suite select open with each suite's status and its one-sentence tooltip
stills.caption: The Suite select lists age-pq/v1 (default) and age/v1 (supported), and the tooltip is the Describe() sentence, word for word.

stills.name: encryption-26-suite-rotate-confirm
stills.reason: Waits on the T2.3 Settings suite select (#1318) and a mock scenario that draws it; becomes capturable with a steps entry once that UI exists.
stills.alt: Settings after choosing another suite: rotate, export and confirm, in that order
stills.caption: Choosing a suite writes no key: the card asks for the rotation, then the bundle export, then the confirmation, and says new copies wait until then.

stills.name: encryption-27-suite-chips
stills.reason: Waits on the T2.3 per-copy suite chip (#1318) and a mock backup with copies under both suites.
stills.alt: A backup's copies, one encrypted under age/v1 and one under age-pq/v1, each with its suite chip
stills.caption: Each encrypted copy shows the suite it was written under, beside the Encrypted and Verified recoverable chips.

stills.name: encryption-28-suite-deprecated-health
stills.reason: Waits on the T2.1 deprecated health state (#1316) reaching the UI through T2.3 (#1318), and a mock scenario with a deprecated suite.
stills.alt: Dashboard health reading degraded because active copies sit under a deprecated suite
stills.caption: A deprecated suite still reads and writes; health says so, with the number of active copies under it.

stills.name: encryption-29-reencrypt-dry-run
stills.reason: Waits on a web control for reencrypt (#1317, #1318); if it stays a command and a route with no button, as encrypt-existing does, this entry is removed with that reason.
stills.alt: The re-encrypt dry run listing copies under age/v1 and what a run would do with each
stills.caption: The dry run lists every copy under the older suite and, per copy, whether a run would re-encrypt it onto another medium or refuse, and why.

gifs.name: encryption-enable-flow
gifs.caption: Switch, the one question, Enable and create key, and the card re-read with the missing-bundle notice.

gifs.name: encryption-bundle-flow
gifs.caption: Export dialog, the tick that arms Download, and the card afterwards saying the bundle is exported and not yet confirmed.

gifs.name: encryption-verify-flow
gifs.alt: Starting a decrypt-verify on an encrypted copy
gifs.caption: Verify recoverable, the egress acceptance, and the running state.
